# Temple Scroll Column 38 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 11QT (Cave 11), Col. 38 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**38:1** And you shall not bring any unclean skin into My temple city; for My temple city shall be clean.

**38:2** And you shall not bring into it the skin of any animal that has died of itself or that has been torn by beasts.

**38:3** In your cities and in your settlements you may use them — but into the temple city you shall not bring them.

**38:4** And you shall not slaughter any clean animal in My temple city within a radius of three days' journey from it.

**38:5** Rather, in your cities you shall slaughter it — each man in his own city, far from My temple city.

**38:6** And you shall not make in it any uncleanness; for I dwell in its midst.

**38:7** And all the skins that you slaughter in your cities — you shall salt them and prepare them in your cities.

**38:8** And you may bring them into My temple city when they are fully prepared and clean.

**38:9** But the flesh of the animal — you shall eat it in the city where you slaughter it; you shall not bring the flesh into My temple city.

**38:10** For the temple city is holy; and only the flesh of the holy offerings and of the votive offerings shall be eaten in it.

**38:11** And all the birds that are clean — they may enter My temple city; and they shall eat them within it.

**38:12** And the turtledoves and the young pigeons that are for offerings — you shall bring them clean into My temple city.

**38:13** And the priests shall offer them upon the altar — the sin offerings and the guilt offerings and the burnt offerings.

**38:14** And no unclean bird shall be found in My temple city; and no unclean bird shall fly over My temple.

**38:15** For My temple city is holy and clean; and I the LORD consecrate it.

**38:16** And you shall keep it holy, as I have commanded you; and you shall not profane My holy city.

---

*EMET notes: Column 38 further regulates the flow of materials into the temple city. The three-day-journey radius for slaughtering (v. 4) creates a vast exclusion zone. The prohibition against unclean birds even flying over the temple (v. 14) is an extreme purity measure unique to 11QT. Skins may enter only after full preparation outside.*
